A New England breakfast flavor built for America’s 31 flavors.

Concept render — maple ice cream, salted caramel ribbon, candied sausage crumble

Baskin-Robbins already proved breakfast can live in a scoop. Chick’n & Waffles and Breakfast in Bed did the work. This is the New England version — maple, brown sugar, sage, and a candied sausage crumble from a 96-year-old Massachusetts sausage house sitting 45 minutes from your Canton headquarters.

The ask

A limited Flavor of the Month built around New England Sausage Company’s candied sausage crumble — not a novelty meat flavor. A dessert. Sticky, maple, salted, and specific to this region.

New England Sausage Company brings the ingredient, the story, and a local brand guests already eat. Baskin-Robbins brings the system, the shops, and the Flavor of the Month machine.

Working name

New England Candied Sausage Crumble

Maple–brown sugar ice cream. Salted maple-caramel ribbon. Candied sausage crumble from New England Sausage Company — maple-glazed, sage, black pepper, brown sugar. Built like Chick’n & Waffles: the savory idea, the dessert execution.

What is in the scoop

LayerWhat it isWhy it belongs
Base Dark maple ice cream with brown sugar and butter Vermont creemee logic. New England already owns maple.
Ribbon Salted maple caramel The same sweet-salt move as BR’s brunch flavors.
Crumble New England Sausage Co. candied sausage — maple glaze, sage, pepper, brown sugar The only piece nobody else can put on a tub. The brand lock.

The crumble is the product. Ice cream is the vehicle. Guests should taste breakfast sausage the way they tasted fried chicken in March 2023 — as flavor architecture, not as a joke.

The ingredient, not a garnish

Candied sausage is maple, fat, salt, and spice cooked until it eats like a sticky brown-sugar cluster. That is a bakery ingredient and an ice cream mix-in. It photographs. It has a story. It is already how New England eats breakfast.

Why Baskin-Robbins, why now

You already ran this play

Chick’n & Waffles: buttermilk waffle ice cream, crispy chick’n-style bites, bourbon maple swirl, zero chicken. Breakfast in Bed: pancake, maple, blueberry. This sits in that lane with a hometown supplier.

The headquarters is here

BR lives at 130 Royall Street, Canton. New England Sausage Company has been in Fall River since 1930 — three generations, Portuguese sausage craft, wholesale into markets and bakeries. This is a Massachusetts-to-Massachusetts conversation.

Regional first, national if it hits

Launch in MA, RI, CT, NH, VT, ME shops. Patriots season, maple season, leaf-peeping traffic. If the tubs move, widen it. If they don’t, it was a hometown month.

A name guests can say

New England Candied Sausage Crumble. Or Maple Sage Crumble featuring New England Sausage Co. No puns. No “link.” The word on the board is crumble.

How it would run

  • Phase 1 — kitchen. BR culinary builds the base and ribbon. New England Sausage Company specs a shelf-stable or frozen candied crumble that survives a cold case and a scoop.
  • Phase 2 — New England month. Flavor of the Month in New England shops. Co-branded case card. One press story: 1930 sausage house × 1945 ice cream house, both Massachusetts.
  • Phase 3 — if it sells. Pint in grocery where BR already plays. Optional cake flavor. NES keeps the crumble as a branded ingredient they can sell elsewhere.

What New England Sausage Company is offering

A real producer, not a flavor house. Family-owned since 1930. Linguiça, chouriço, and traditional sausage from Fall River. Already in New England markets and bakeries. Ready to develop a candied maple-sage crumble specifically for frozen dessert — and to put the company name on the flavor so the scoop is not generic “breakfast sausage.”

That is the difference between a test-kitchen gag and a collaboration. The ingredient has a face, a town, and almost a century of making sausage people actually buy.

Next step

A 30-minute call with culinary / brand at Canton. New England Sausage Company brings sample direction for the crumble. Baskin-Robbins says whether this is a Flavor of the Month test or a pass. No long courtship required to know if the idea belongs on the board.
